title: Load a User from an API
prompt:
A fake `fetch` is provided that returns a promise resolving to a response object with `.ok` (true) and `.json()` (resolves to { name: "Ada", role: "learner" }).

1. Write an async function `loadUser()` that awaits fetch("https://api.example.com/me"), checks response.ok (throw on failure), awaits response.json(), and RETURNS the parsed user object.
2. Call loadUser() and log the returned user's name — should print Ada.

tests.name: returns the parsed user object
tests.hint: const response = await fetch(url); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(...); return await response.json();

tests.name: checks response.ok and awaits json()
tests.hint: if (!response.ok) throw new Error(...); — then response.json().

tests.name: logs the fetched name
